note: Filled from the monthly parish calendar PDFs. One entry per event: date YYYY-MM-DD (end_date optional), title, time, text, optional image (file in static/img/ without .jpg) and image_alt; add "image_small": true for small calendar clip-art pictures. Events move from 'Coming up' to 'Past events' automatically after their date.

events.title: Feast of the Archangel Michael
events.text: Sunday Liturgy on the feast of St. Michael and all the bodiless powers of heaven, with coffee hour following.

events.title: Beginning of the Nativity Fast
events.text: The forty-day fast of preparation for Christmas begins.

events.title: Entrance of the Theotokos into the Temple
events.time: Friday 6:00 PM Vigil; Saturday 9:30 AM Divine Liturgy
events.text: We celebrate the day the young Virgin Mary was brought to the Temple and dedicated to God. Visitors are always welcome at feast-day services.

events.title: Tea for the Theotokos
events.text: A parish tea gathering in honor of the Mother of God.
events.image_alt: A teapot pouring tea into cups, beside a red cross seal with the letters IC XC NI KA

events.title: Bonfire at Fr. Arkady's
events.text: An evening of fellowship around the fire. Ask for directions if you need them.

events.title: Thanksgiving Day Liturgy
events.text: We begin Thanksgiving Day by giving thanks to God together at the Divine Liturgy.

events.title: Moleben to St. Elizabeth and church cleaning
events.text: A short service of prayer to our patron saint, followed by cleaning and caring for our church together.

events.title: Men's pilgrimage to St. Gregory Palamas Monastery
events.text: A pilgrimage for the men of the parish.

events.title: Feast of St. Nicholas
events.text: Sunday Liturgy on the feast of St. Nicholas the Wonderworker, followed by a special visitor and coffee hour.

events.title: Feast of St. Herman of Alaska
events.text: Sunday Liturgy honoring St. Herman, the first saint of the Orthodox Church in America.

events.title: Moleben and church cleaning
events.text: Prayer together, then preparing our church for the Nativity of Christ.

events.title: Nativity of Our Lord (Christmas)
events.time: Christmas Eve 6:00 PM Vigil; Christmas Day 9:30 AM Divine Liturgy
events.text: The great feast of Christ's birth. A beautiful time to visit an Orthodox church for the first time.

events.title: Feast of St. Arkady
events.text: Divine Liturgy on the name day of our pastor, Fr. Arkady.

events.title: Nativity concert and potluck
events.text: Christmas music and a shared potluck meal on the Sunday after the Nativity. Everyone is welcome.

events.title: Feast of St. Basil the Great
events.text: New Year's Day Liturgy on the feast of St. Basil.

events.title: Our first Pascha in Walbridge
events.text: We celebrated the Resurrection of Christ for the first time in our new church, with the midnight procession by candlelight and a joyful Paschal meal together.
events.image_alt: Parishioners holding candles outside the church doors at night during the Paschal procession

events.title: First Divine Liturgy in our Walbridge church
events.text: On Palm Sunday, the parish served its first Liturgy in the historic 1883 church on East Broadway, our new home.
events.image_alt: Parishioners at the first Divine Liturgy in the Walbridge church, Palm Sunday 2024
